us:n4:806.problem: Two defects. (1) wrong[2] 「このパートはとてもおいしいです」 has a rescuing reading: colloquial おいしい in the sense lucrative / a sweet deal collocates precisely with part-time work (おいしいバイト, おいしい仕事), so a native reads it as this part-time job pays really well - acceptable Japanese, and the item then has two defensible answers. This is the class _README.md rejects (「土曜日にパーティーを開けます」). Replaced with 「妹はパートを着て学校へ行きました。」, which no reading rescues. (2) The key is the ONLY option ending in 。, so the item is answerable without reading any Japanese; all 182 shipped usage items terminate every wrong sentence in 。 and none has this tell. Recorded, not fixed: the stem also carries ごめん (御免, vocab:1270670, n2, untaught, level agreement 1/3) and is a two-sentence option, but the only other level-clean パート sentence (sent:tatoeba-210043) uses the section sense the vocab record does not carry.
